title: Software Dev Engineer I, L4
description: DESCRIPTION You use technology to validate and verify software, seeking input from team members on the best software test techniques to utilize. Your scope of work is to extend and effectively apply existing automation frameworks for small to mid-size components and/or product features. You may create or have responsibility to improve existing test tools. You are able to take a defined design and turn it into code and deliver it on schedule, applying appropriate technologies and current software engineering best practices. You write secure, stable, testable, maintainable code with minimal defects. You are proficient in a broad range of data structures and algorithms, knowing when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You make appropriate implementation trade-off decisions (e.g., array or hash table?). You do not put the company at risk (e.g. pulling in unlicensed code, working on code in unsafe ways, test payment transactions in prod, etc.). You participate in team design, scoping and prioritization discussions. Your input to test plans and test cases are of high quality and high value. You seek to learn the business context and technologies behind your team’s software. You invent, refine and develop your solutions to ensure they are meeting team needs and project goals. You are a passionate advocate for your customer. You assume responsibility for the state of the code you inherit, produce, and test. You get your designs, code, and test plans reviewed. You test code thoroughly. You classify, store, and handle data in accordance with Amazon policies. You track risks and mitigate and/or escalate them in a timely manner. You take the time to understand the maintenance characteristics, runtime properties, and dependencies of your team’s software, including hardware platform, operating system and build dependencies. You prevent bugs from causing customer pain. You clearly document your software to ensure that future generations of developers understand the intention behind the test solutions you build. You troubleshoot, research the root cause of problems, and thoroughly resolve defects. You take ownership of problems (even when outside your own domain), propose solutions, and either take ownership for their resolution or ensure a clear hand-off to the right owner. You participate in the interview process and help your team train and mentor SDE-T interns. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering Experience of 1 to 3 years as an SDE PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Exposure to AWS, Full stack development experience Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description: First, who are we? We're AquaAirX Autonomous Systems - a Bengaluru-based deep-tech First, who are we? title: AI/ML Research Intern
description: Company: The Wedding Company (TWC) Location: Bengaluru Type: Full-time Internship (6 months) | PPO Opportunity Eligibility: M.Tech/MS students or recent graduates in AI, ML, Computer Science, or related fields About The Wedding Company The Wedding Company is building an AI-powered operating system for the wedding industry , combining visual intelligence, conversational AI, personalized recommendations, and data-driven decision-making. AI is at the core of our platform, powering real-world products used by customers and internal teams. We work with large proprietary datasets of wedding images, customer conversations, and historical wedding information. We're looking for a passionate AI/ML Research Intern with strong fundamentals in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and Generative AI who can improve existing AI systems and help build new capabilities. This is a hands-on research and engineering role with significant technical ownership and an opportunity to transition into a full-time AI/ML Engineer position. What You'll Work On 1. AI Decor Intelligence System (Existing) Our AI-powered decor platform uses embeddings, clustering, and visual similarity to generate personalized, aesthetically coherent wedding mood boards from 40,000+ curated decor images. Develop and optimize image embedding and similarity search pipelines. Improve semantic matching, visual coherence, and intelligent image recommendations. Experiment with computer vision, multimodal models, and generative AI techniques. Scale image retrieval and recommendation systems toward 100,000+ images. 2. AI Ideabook — Multimodal Search (Existing) Our inspiration discovery platform supports text-to-image and image-to-image search across 25,000+ wedding-related images. Improve natural-language and reference-image search. Experiment with models such as CLIP, SigLIP, and other open-source embedding architectures. Optimize vector search, retrieval accuracy, and ranking algorithms. 3. AI Meeting & Product Intelligence (Existing) Our platform uses speech recognition and LLMs to transform customer conversations and behavioral data into actionable intelligence. Work on speech-to-text transcription and LLM-based conversation analysis. Extract user preferences, decisions, action items, and risks. Build intelligent classification, prediction, and recommendation systems. Combine conversational insights with product usage and behavioral signals. 4. Domain-Specific LLM & RAG Platform (Upcoming) We're developing an AI-powered wedding planning assistant using proprietary wedding data, historical insights, and multimodal retrieval. Research and develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. Experiment with open-source LLMs, Gemini, and models accessible through OpenRouter. Build context-aware retrieval and personalized recommendation capabilities. Explore multimodal RAG, fine-tuning, and AI agents. Technical Skills & Requirements Must Have Strong Python programming and ML/DL fundamentals. Knowledge of PyTorch or TensorFlow. Understanding of Computer Vision, image processing, embeddings, clustering, and semantic similarity. Familiarity with transformers, neural networks, and model training. Hands-on familiarity with Hugging Face and open-source AI models . Understanding of the ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, optimization, and deployment. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to independently experiment with AI models. Good to Have Experience with CLIP, SigLIP, DINO, or other vision-language models. Familiarity with vector databases such as Weaviate, FAISS, Qdrant, or Milvus. Experience with LLMs, OpenRouter, RAG, or AI agents. Knowledge of model fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, quantization, and GPU inference. Exposure to speech recognition, NLP, FastAPI, Docker, or cloud infrastructure. Experience implementing research papers, customizing models, or contributing to open-source AI projects. Who Should Apply? We're looking for M.Tech/MS/Masters/Postgrad students who: Have built meaningful AI/ML projects, particularly in Computer Vision, Deep Learning, or Generative AI. Enjoy exploring Hugging Face, GitHub repositories, and new research papers. Can understand, modify, fine-tune, and experiment with existing ML models. Have strong analytical abilities and enjoy translating research into practical applications. Want to own real AI systems rather than just integrate third-party APIs. Prior industry experience is not required. Strong academic projects, research implementations, and GitHub contributions are highly valued. Why Join TWC? Work on real AI products using proprietary image and conversational datasets. Experiment with modern open-source models and multimodal AI technologies. Gain end-to-end ownership of AI systems, from research to production. Work directly with the founding and engineering teams. Opportunity for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) based on performance.
